programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery and bloodshed.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1
programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: Biwi.Com
programme.desc: When a pandit predicts that Kishan will marry thrice in his lifetime, his wife Shilpa forces him into a second marriage. When the wives start fighting, a third woman arrives from London for Kishan.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.desc: S2 — The Tale of Dr Bobtail's AdventureWhen Squirrel Nutkin feels too poorly to move, the rabbits must sneak Dr Bobtail onto Owl Island.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S1 E13 — The Lost Sea StarCaptain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. When the Octonauts find an unusual Sea Star on the beach, they search the ocean from top to bottom to help find its home.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Ice ScreamBetty the ice cream van is so full of ice cream that it's making her speed around town out of control. It's up to Mojo and Bo with the Racer Top to stop her and save those treats.

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Match of the DenMatch of the Day is coming to film the Fantastics, but Jaz is injured. Can she get on TV?

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S11 E21 — We're All Friends: AutumnJustin has lots of autumn fun with his friends, but Mr Tumble is struggling to play football because lots of leaves are blocking the goal!

programme.title: Mr Tumble
programme.desc: Mr Tumble's Alphabet SongSing and sign along to Mr Tumble's 'Alphabet Song'.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Horsey RideThe kids put together a horsey wedding to distract Socks when she refuses to let go of Bluey's favourite toy, with dad and Uncle Stripe acting as the horses.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E39 — ExerciseDad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S1 E3 — The Hair BadgeWhen Duggee has a bad hair day, the squirrels have lots of ideas and things to try to make his hair look better.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S1 E4 — The Summer Holiday BadgeThe Squirrels are out tobogganing with Duggee when they spot a migrating bird fall from the sky, and they give him more summer things since he only has a camera and a toothbrush.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E11 — Slow Clinic DayOn a rare day without patients, Zog and Gadabout can't wait to unwind - but Pearl can't stop doctoring! They must help her relax before she bandages every creature in sight.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E36 — The Piri Rule BookFlutter is sent to the 'naughty berg' as punishment when he falls foul of an old Piri rule. But when the others start telling tales, he's not the only one to be banished.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Bouncy WishRafi loves bouncing on the trampoline and wishes she could keep bouncing all day. Her feet become bouncy like trampolines, and at first it feels brilliant. But bouncing everywhere makes simple jobs tricky - cups topple over, eggs splatting, and even hugs are hard. Rafi doesn't want help, but soon she sees that bouncing all the time isn't as fun as she thought. With her dads, she realises it's okay to ask for help. Together they share pancakes, laughter, and a big upside-down hug.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: S1 E12 — All About HomeCosima is so excited to tell Big Lizard about her life on Earth that she doesn't realise he has something exciting to say to her.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: S3 E13 — Freeze, It's Doc Ock!; Go, Go, JeffDoc Ock's new invention turns people into frozen statues, and the team must save the day before the whole city freezes. Team Spidey must save Jeff when he accidentally tries on Spidey's new Web-Spinner boots.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: S4 E24 — Spider Crab SurpriseThe Octonauts expand their exploration beyond the sea and onto land. With new rides and new friends, they are prepared to protect any habitats and animals at risk on land or underwater.

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: S1 E13 — Mission Movie MessWhen Lauchie and Scarlett film a movie with their toys in the garden, Silver Paw tries to hijack the spotlight and become the superstar.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Meet GingerGinger narrowly escapes becoming lunch for a swarm of hungry Pea-Rex, but ends up with a P-Rex pod stuck on her tail. The pod soon hatches to reveal three baby Pea-Rex.

programme.title: GiggleQuiz
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Dina Lady's Brussel Sprout CakeJoining Gail and Keith for today's GiggleQuiz are Wizard Tripwick and Dina Lady. Dina makes a Brussels Sprout Cake, and while attempting to use magic to think of an answer, Wizard Tripwick accidentally causes Gail to ribbet like a frog.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Time MachineRebecca is keen to go on a travelling adventure and invites Murphy to come. Murphy's time machine takes them to the dinosaur age, but when it stops working, they need to get making. Firstly, they create a paper plate dinosaur, followed by some colourful water blob creatures made by the Mini Monsters. Then, Rebecca gets a call on the Magic Monster Mirror from her aunt Antarctic, who makes herself some snow-building buddies to help rescue her snowman.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: S1 E21 — We're All Potatoes at HeartMeet potatoes from around the world as they celebrate the similarities and differences we all share, with a zydeco tune.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Marina's Mexican EnchiladasToday's talented chef takes us to Mexico, cooking a traditional dish called enchiladas. Marina's dad has shown her how to make the recipe, which she really loves to eat. Marina grates, mixes and wraps up all her ingredients in tortilla bread and finishes with a squeeze of lime. Her friends think the lime is a bit sour when they taste it, but hopefully they will be impressed by her cooking and her special guest musicians: a traditional mariachi band.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: S1 E17 — The Rhinos Play the Noticing GameThe rhinos play a noticing game, Hamza sees some vervet monkeys, and Zuri enjoys a snack.

programme.title: Down on the Farm
programme.desc: S2 E6 — Pumpkins and ApplesStorm visits Yorkshire to find out all about pumpkins and joins some friends for a spooky pumpkin party. JB goes to a ploughing competition, and JB also picks lots of different types of apples and discovers how to make apple juice.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Waffle and the Swimming PoolWaffle has so much fun on a doggy play date at Mr Willow's house that he decides to stay for a sleepover! The Brooklyn-Bells miss Waffle and can't wait for his return.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E18 — The Making Friends BadgeThe Squirrels are off for a jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee but everything they do is different, even Roly finds one of them too loud.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S4 E20 — Octonauts and the CoelacanthThe Octonauts find the fossil of a prehistoric fish while exploring a dark and creepy cave, but it's more than just a regular fossil.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: S1 — Vida's Wandering WondersWhen Vida's vet bag goes missing, it's up to her and her Sweetwoodian friends to track it down. Not only do they find it, but they also discover a hermit crab in need of a new home.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: S2 E20 — Tower Bridge, LondonGrandmaster Glitch is visiting London and spots the perfect souvenir at a riverside stall - a majestic hat that was clearly made for a Grandmaster! But when he finds he has no money, he decides to raise some by working as a tour guide on the River Thames. The Go Jetters are also visiting London while Lars helps to fix his favourite bridge - Tower Bridge. Ubercorn explains that this amazing bridge can be raised to allow tall river traffic to pass safely beneath.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: S1 E15 — The Triple EclipseCosima and Big Lizard race against time to retrieve sun goggles so they can watch a cosmic triple eclipse.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E20 — Chrysalis CrecheTapTap becomes very protective when strange eggs appear in the branches of her tree, so everyone helps keep the garden nice and quiet. TapTap is amazed to find that her eggs are in fact chrysalises, from which some beautiful butterflies emerge.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: S1 E2 — TheatreOn a rainy day, the Froglets create a shadow show for Bertie and their puppet friends.

programme.title: Mr Tumble's Nursery Rhymes
programme.desc: S1 E2 — We're OffSinging and signing nursery rhymes all about transport with Mr Tumble.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S14 E21 — We're All Friends: Dressing UpMr Tumble has some fancy dress fun pretending to be all kinds of different things, including a spaceman, a ballerina, and a bunny.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: S2 E13 — Mission: BirdwatcherDan the border collie is a search and rescue dog who works with his owner Jamie. His super nose follows scents and smells like clues so they can rescue people who need their help.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: S1 E1 — One-Man BandPC Plum is determined to perform Great-Granny Plum's song at the Balamory ceilidh all by himself, but he soon realises it isn't easy being a one-man band.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Tick Tick BoomBoom is showing off but slips and has a mild panic. To hide his embarrassment, he challenges Zog to a dragon-off! Zog must set aside his desire to win and help his rival.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Favourite ThingAt dinner, the Heelers play a game called 'My Favourite Thing Today' and take turns remembering their favourite thing from the day. However, when Bluey laughs at something her sister said earlier, Bingo's mood darkens.

programme.title: Steve and Aneeshwar Go Wild
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Flamingo and OrangutanSteve and Aneeshwar meet colourful flamingos and feed them their breakfast, before meeting up with some orangutans to see how they have an extraordinary skill in common with each other.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: S2 E16 — LycheeLive from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's love and peace symbol Lychee performing his song 'All You Need Is Lychee'.

programme.title: Tish Tash
programme.desc: S1 E7 — The Missing TortoiseTish has a collection of 'Surprise Egg Friend' figurines, but Tiny Turtle is nowhere to be seen. Tish enlists the help of Dad, and together they embark on a quest into the darkest nooks and crannies under Tish's bed.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: S3 E15 — Who's The Best?When Otto, Oona and Isabelle fly around the island to get some materials for the Hoots' log, Isabelle's position as top flyer is challenged.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: S1 E11 — Clear Out DayLove Monster tries to share an old disco ball with his friends, but they all want to do different things with it.

programme.title: Numberblocks

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: S1 E1 — RedAn excitable Red arrives in Colourland. Learn about the colour red with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: S1 E25 — Sports DayZiff, Pipp and Button compete in their own Froggie sports day.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: S2 E13 — Cotton WoolBella and Lift visit Tincy, who has fluffy snowballs stuck fast in her spiderweb.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Top of the PotsSonny and Yukee are distracted by the amazing musical properties of a pile of old salvaged pots. Unfortunately, Sonny has promised some of the pots to Twinkle, who becomes increasingly impatient while Sonny and Yukee play.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Pop Goes the WeaselLisa and a group of deaf and hearing children meet in Tall Trees Forest to make cheeky pop-up weasel puppets, then they sing and sign Pop Goes the Weasel, learning the signs for rice and weasel.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: S2 E1 — I've Lost My Bobble HatWhile sorting through his hats, Nick realises his favourite hat is missing, but the Podcast song of the day might be able to help him find it.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E15 — The Wishing TreeNugget attempts to make all her Piri friends' secret 'wishing tree' hopes and dreams come true - but gets them the wrong way round, with funny and very unexpected consequences.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E12 — A Friend for FergusZog and the doctors want to find Fergus a friend to cure his loneliness. Boom, Twiggy and Mara all try to be his new pal.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Driving WishRafi learns that changing the plan can lead to an even better adventure.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: S2 E27 — Music FixerSarah is a 7-year-old girl with big eyes and a green hat, who lives with her quacky, flappy, slightly manic but endearing best friend Duck. The pair embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way.

programme.desc: S1 E11 — Pepi Nana and Mr Onion in the Tub!Pepi Nana finds little toy tub hiding in her wardrobe. Little Nana wishes it was a great big tub.

programme.title: Mary Poppins Returns
programme.desc: In 1930s London, Michael Banks lives in his family home with his children, Annabel, John, and Georgie. Still grieving the death of his wife, and behind on loan payments, his house is due to be repossessed unless he comes up with the money soon. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: National Treasure
programme.desc: An intrepid treasure-hunter follows a series of ingenious clues in a perilous quest to track down a war chest hidden by America's founding fathers generations before. He has to contend with determined rivals in the shape of a treacherous associate and the FBI. Action adventure, starring Nicolas Cage, Diane Kruger, Sean Bean and Justin Bartha.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: A fairy falls in love with an ambitious human nobleman, who betrays her in pursuit of claiming the throne. She swears to get revenge on him by placing a curse on his daughter, only to find herself developing a maternal bond with the girl. Fantasy adventure based on the story of Sleeping Beauty, starring Angelina Jolie, Elle Fanning, Sharlto Copley and Imelda Staunton.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.title: 28 Weeks Later
programme.desc: The US military oversees the repopulation of Britain after a virus that turned those infected into bloodthirsty killers finally dies out. Two children sneak away from a London safe zone and make a discovery that threatens to unleash the virus again. Juan Carlos Fresnadillo's horror sequel to 28 Days Later, with Robert Carlyle, Rose Byrne, Jeremy Renner, Imogen Poots and Idris Elba.

programme.title: Alien: Covenant
programme.desc: A crew of colonists sent to populate an alien planet have their mission diverted by a mysterious signal. After landing on a nearby world, they discover what became of the ill-fated Prometheus mission. Ridley Scott's sci-fi thriller, starring Katherine Waterston, Michael Fassbender and Danny McBride.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A nameless stay-at-home Mother tends to her young son in the suburbs while Husband casually goes out to work. Trapped in a whirlpool of rage and frustration about the loss of her identity, Mother becomes convinced that she is turning into one of the dogs that roam the neighbourhood. Dark comedy adapted from Rachel Yoder's novel, starring Amy Adams and Scoot McNairy.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: George of the Jungle
programme.desc: An American heiress on holiday in Africa gets stranded in the wilderness, but is rescued by a primitive man who was raised by apes. When her cruel fiancee takes her back to the States, the besotted king of the jungle follows, but is unprepared for modern living. Comedy based on the TV cartoon series, starring Brendan Fraser, Leslie Mann, Thomas Haden Church and Richard Roundtree.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Raya and the Last Dragon
programme.desc: Chief Benja and his 'dragon nerd' daughter Raya proudly protect a luminescent stone that protects humanity from a plague borne of discord called the Druun. One poor judgement allows the darkness to return, and Raya embarks on a perilous quest to restore peace by completing a series of Indiana-Jones-style obstacles. Animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Marie Tran, Awkwafina, Izaac Wang and Gemma Chan.

programme.title: The Lion King
programme.desc: After the murder of his father Mufasa, young lion prince Simba flees his African kingdom, only to learn the true meaning of responsibility and bravery as he clashes with his wicked uncle Scar. Director Jon Favreau's animated remake of Disney's 1994 blockbuster, featuring the voices of Donald Glover, Beyonce Knowles and Seth Rogen.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: Wall-e
programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.title: The Princess Diaries
programme.desc: An ordinary teenager discovers she is descended from royal stock and her grandmother is a queen. However, when this formidable regal lady insists she learn to behave like a princess, life suddenly becomes very complicated. Family comedy, starring Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Heather Matarazzo and Hector Elizondo.

programme.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
programme.desc: The wise-cracking mercenary teams up with the resurrected X-Men veteran to take on a lethal adversary. Superhero sequel, starring Ryan Reynolds, Hugh Jackman, Emma Corrin and Matthew Macfadyen.

programme.title: Let's Be Cops
programme.desc: Two friends go to a fancy-dress party as police officers, and are amazed by how people on the street react to their uniforms. They decide to pose as cops in the hope of enjoying the perks of the job, but soon end up in over their heads with gangsters and corrupt members of the real force. Comedy, starring Jake Johnson and Damon Wayans Jr.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters

They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: FilmSpy
programme.desc: FilmSpy.

programme.title: Starship Troopers
programme.desc: Courageous military recruits hurl themselves into a desperate war against alien insects set on destroying mankind. They blast off for the creatures' home planet in a last-ditch attempt to save the human race from annihilation - little realising the carnage that awaits them. Sci-fi adventure from director Paul Verhoeven, starring Casper Van Dien, Denise Richards and Dina Meyer.

programme.title: Bad Company
programme.desc: A secret agent is murdered, leaving his veteran CIA partner to transform the dead man's streetwise twin from an uncouth hustler into a credible replacement for his brother, so the agency can continue its investigation into a diabolical terrorist plot involving a nuclear bomb. Comedy thriller, starring Anthony Hopkins, Chris Rock, Peter Stormare, Gabriel Macht and John Slattery.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: The Lion King
programme.desc: After the murder of his father Mufasa, young lion prince Simba flees his African kingdom, only to learn the true meaning of responsibility and bravery as he clashes with his wicked uncle Scar. Director Jon Favreau's animated remake of Disney's 1994 blockbuster, featuring the voices of Donald Glover, Beyonce Knowles and Seth Rogen.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Mufasa: The Lion King
programme.desc: Mufasa, a cub lost and alone, meets a sympathetic lion named Taka, the heir to a royal bloodline - a chance meeting which sets in motion an expansive journey of a group of misfits searching for their destiny. Prequel to Disney's live-action 2019 movie, with the voices of Aaron Pierre, Kelvin Harrison Jnr and Tiffany Boone.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.desc: Flavor Explosion. Guy Fieri dives into a flavour overload with next-level tacos in Mobile, Alabama, Indian street food in Alberta, Canada, and vegan twists in Los Angeles. S38, Ep9

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: Local Celebrities. Fearing the staff are getting carried away with producing digital shorts to promote Amalfi's in Portland, OR, the owners call in the mystery diners to investigate. S8, Ep8

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: Memorabilia Mayhem. The owner of Rock Island Cafe in Honolulu is concerned about a drop in his restaurant's memorabilia sales. The mystery diners go undercover to investigate. S8, Ep9

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Creepy Crawly Cake And Haunted House. It's Halloween and Buddy's eldest son wants a haunted house to match his spooky cake. Carlo's crew create an intricate carved pumpkin cake. S9, Ep11

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Dreams Come True. Rapper Fat Joe wants a cake to celebrate his new hit single, and Buddy's design is as good as gold! Plus, the team create a Gingerbread Man-inspired cake. S9, Ep12

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Meaty To Meatless. Guy Fieri digs into dishes with and without meat, like righteous rabbit in Alabama, meatless chicken in Nebraska and gangster Greek in Connecticut. S38, Ep7

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Barefoot Classics. Ina revisits some Barefoot bestsellers and gives them a little upgrade. She makes easy sticky buns, mustard chicken salad and a roasted vegetable soup. S1, Ep19

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Comfort And Company. Ina shares her favourite comfort food for when she's having guests over. She serves up company pot roast and baked potatoes with yoghurt and sour cream. S1, Ep20

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Fast And Fabulous. Ina's friend is coming over and she's whipping up some amazing dishes. She prepares mustard roasted fish and honey vanilla fromage blanc with raspberry sauce. S1, Ep21

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Pack And Go Party. Ina shares simple dishes perfect for a picnic. On the menu is pita tabbouleh and feta, roasted shrimp salad and ginger cookies served with peaches. S1, Ep22

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Easy French. Ina demonstrates how to make delicious French food at home. She prepares a roasted butternut squash salad with warm cider vinaigrette and an apple tart. S1, Ep17

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: The Magic Factor. Ina experiments in the kitchen by testing recipes with and without their magic ingredient. She makes chicken salad sandwiches and chocolate ganache cupcakes. S1, Ep18

programme.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Sicily. Jamie travels to the island of Sicily in search of sensational home-cooked recipes. Plus, he is inspired to cook an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Tuscany. Jamie is in Tuscany to track down the grandmothers who hold the key to the region's farmhouse cooking. And, he makes a beef stew with homemade pappardelle pasta. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: Michel makes mouth-watering pork steaks with asparagus and courgettes. Later, he demonstrates how to cook the perfect souffléed cheese omelette. S1, Ep8

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: Comfort Food. James Martin explores warm and cosy comfort desserts. He creates all the classics, including a rhubarb crumble with custard, spotted dick and a sticky toffee pudding. S1, Ep9

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: Chocolate. James Martin makes chocolate the key ingredient in his desserts. He creates a chocolate cake and chocolate brownies, as well as a stunning chocolate box with truffles. S1, Ep10

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: Celebration Cakes. James Martin focuses on cakes made for special occasions. He demonstrates many beautiful celebration cakes including the classic black forest gateau. S1, Ep11

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: Tarts. James Martin, one of Britain's top dessert makers, explores the many varieties of sweet tarts. But, which of his stunning tart recipes will he demonstrate? S1, Ep12

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's American Feast
programme.desc: Vermont. Tom Kerridge travels to Vermont to experience fantastic food. He makes his own version of maple and bourbon-glazed chicken wings and samples the states maple syrup. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's American Feast
programme.desc: Washington DC. Tom Kerridge travels to Washington DC to experience fantastic food. He puts his own spin on mac and cheese, using luxurious truffles and four cheeses. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's American Feast
programme.desc: Florida Keys. Tom Kerridge travels to the Florida Keys to the tropical cuisine. He cooks a blackened spice sea bass with coconut rice and pineapple salsa and goes fishing. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's American Feast
programme.desc: Best Of. Tom Kerridge looks back at his favourite moments of the American culinary road trip. He uses everything he's learned, to create his take on the American beef burger. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Best Ever Dishes
programme.desc: Crowd Pleasers. Chef Tom Kerridge shares his recipes for great party food. He makes luxury loaded potato skins, slow cooked pulled beef brisket in a bun and a chocolate tart. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multi-part venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Emily Scott is the chef proprietor of Cornwall's renowned `St Tudy Inn'. Her two rivals are from across the sea on Jersey. Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, `No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred `Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Emily's David Bowie inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes and she's using Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Joe has sourced his ingredients locally too, using hay from his family farm and Jersey beef.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs need to impress the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate. They are joined by one half of the synthpop duo The Communards, Reverend Richard Coles.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Tom `Westy' Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant `The Classroom' in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheriden formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Andy cooks venison in celebration of his favourite band, Oasis. He accompanies the loin with rhubarb and beetroot ketchup, black pudding purée, pickled beetroot and a pistachio crumb. Westy's beef dish `The Cow Shed' is named after a former stage at the Glastonbury festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs begin by cooking their starters for a surprise veteran of the competition. Chris' dish `Brixton Academy Through the Years' is his refined take on the classic lamb, post gig junk food he ate after nights out at Brixton Academy.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Chris is cooking his interpretation of the classic beef dish Tournedos Rossini using guinea fowl. His inspiration is Proms in the Park and the British artists who mix classical and modern music styles. Alex's dish commemorates his late brother and the song by Northern Ireland artist DonnaTaggart that he associates with the difficult time of his death.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Northern Ireland will recreate their four course menu for the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver. There's also a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs battle to get their starter course to the Abbey Road banquet and don't disappoint with stunning dishes dedicated to everything from Tom Jones to Grime. The rivals are cooking to impress food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver, plus guest judge and British music legend Martin Kemp.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Some of the finest chefs in the UK compete to cook a fish course worthy of serving at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road Studios. Along with the show's panel of expert judges, the rivals need to impress guest judge Kanya King.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The eight regional champions will compete to get their main courses onto the final menu of the banquet at Abbey Road Studios.They will be cooking for the judges food critic, Mathew Fort, cook and broadcaster Andi Oliver and restaurateur, Oliver Peyton plus guest judge, former Wham! star, Andrew Ridgeley. As ever, the judges will be looking for dishes laced with star quality and a good sprinkling of rock and roll wow factor worth of a banquet full of the music industry's finest.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Some of the country's finest chefs compete over the final place cooking at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road studios. Each rival will need to cook a dessert to impress a panel of expert judges, along with guest judge Peter Hook, Joy Division and New Order bassist, and pioneer of Britain's Madchester scene.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs must cook in an unfamiliar kitchen and scale up their dishes to provide the highest calibre of dining for a full banquet room of diners. Their guests are celebrities and unsung heroes who have helped create British music's unparalleled global reputation.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The spotlight is on Scotland. Returning contenders Michael Smith, Tony Singh and Mark Greenaway are all determined to get one of their dishes to the banquet. Will a witty take on spiced ham score highly, or will a warm chicken salad with a twist or a rabbit terrine come out on top? Veteran judge Angela Hartnett MBE will be judging.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Returning contenders Michael Smith, Tony Singh and Mark Greenaway cook their fish dishes. Will a traditional Scottish soup, a chowder or a risky no-cook mackerel dish impress veteran judge Angela Hartnett MBE?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The competition heats up as the three returning Scottish contenders, Michael Smith, Tony Singh and Mark Greenaway, cook their main courses. An African inspired goat tagine, a beef dish inspired by a childhood cartoon and a duck dish with a comedy twist are dished up for veteran judge Angela Hartnett MBE.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Scottish returning contenders Michael Smith, Tony Singh and Mark Greenaway have just one more chance to impress veteran judge Angela Hartnett MBE and win their place in front of the judges. Will a comedy custard pie, a sophisticated chocolate dessert or doughnuts inspired by a Scottish tradition come out on top?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Only one chef can make it through to the national finals to represent Scotland and cook at a special banquet at the Royal Albert Hall.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The curtain raises on the competition in the North West. How will Aiden Byrne's dish entitled `Mad as a Box of Frogs' go down with veteran Phil Howard? Will he trounce Mary-Ellen McTague's crab starter or will Chris Holland's `Oriental style beef broth with a twis' score more highly with Phil?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The North West chefs cook their fish courses. Will Aiden Byrne's `The Culinary Joke' - a take on a classic prawn cocktail - raise a laugh, or will Mary-Ellen McTague's dish of dover sole or Chris Holland's `Gone Fishing' salmon dish prove winners?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their main course. Will Aiden Byrne's witty beef dish entitled `Long Horn Beef with Noodle Pot' prove a winner, or will Mary-Ellen McTague's goat dish called `Our Kid' raise a smile? Perhaps Chris Holland will score highly with his dish called `A Tasting of Pork'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the chef's last chance to impress before the final two are chosen to face the `Great British Menu' judging panel. Which dessert will help get them through? Will it be Aiden Byrne's pineapple dish called `The Sweet Burger', Mary-Ellen McTague's take on a trifle called `Chamomile Lawn' or Chris Holland's dish called `Going Bananas'?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's decision time for the chefs from the North West. One chef has already left the competition and only two remain. The judges are joined by celebrity guest judge writer, presenter and performer Rowland Rivron.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's decision time for the chefs from the North West. One chef has already left the competition and only two remain. The judges are joined by celebrity guest judge writer, presenter and performer Rowland Rivron.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: In central England, three culinary heavyweights return to the `Great British Menu' kitchen. Two Michelin star chef Daniel Clifford creates a dish called `A Trip to the Chippy', where nothing is as it first appears. That is also the theme for Michelin star chef Richard Bainbridge's starter, `banana split', while Will Holland offers up goats cheese mousse, balsamic jelly and gingerbread.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Here, the chefs try to impress with their fish courses. Daniel Clifford puts up a creative dish called `Catch of the Day'. Does Richard Bainbridge's dish titled `Tongue in Cheek' live up to its comedy name? Will judge Marcus Wareing find the comedy value in Will Holland's coconut poached brill, crab, celeriac and tomato essence?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs in central England cook their main courses. Daniel Clifford's main has the same title as Richard Bainbridge's fish course, `Tongue in Cheek', but it is a wildly different plate of food; Richard Bainbridge presents guinea fowl in a beef bladder and calls the dish `Which Came First: the Chicken or the Egg'; Will Holland offers roast longhorn beef rib eye, bread and bone marrow pudding and parsley paste.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs in central England have one last chance to impress Marcus Wareing before the final two are chosen to face the judging panel. Will Daniel Clifford's `Going Out with a Bang' be good enough? Has Richard Bainbridge dropped the comedy ball with his coffee and chocolate dessert called `Time to Reflect'? Or will an unusual dish of parsnip banoffee cake, chocolate tart and parsnip ice cream get Will Holland through?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's decision time for the chefs from the central England region. Only two chefs remain to cook their entire menus for judges Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. The panel is joined by guest judge, comedian and actor Jim Moir, known to millions as Vic Reeves.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The South West chefs battle it out for a chance to cook at the special banquet. Will veteran judge Tom Kerridge like Chris Eden's modern twist on `Duck a l'Orange', or will he favour Peter Sanchez-Iglesias' dish called `Picnic'? Perhaps Emily Watkins's witty dish called `Eggs and Ham' will prove a winner.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The South West chefs cook their fish courses here. Cornishman Chris Eden takes inspiration from home to create a lobster and oyster dish called `Gone Surfing', Peter Sanchez-Iglesias cooks up a dish inspired by childhood memories titled `Fish and Chips', while Emily Watkins serves up a dish with cured trout called `High Tea'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The South West chefs cook their main courses and veteran Tom Kerridge is looking for perfection. Will Chris Eden's spin on a fast food classic simply called `B.L.T' gain top points? Or will Peter Sanchez Iglesias' nostalgic dish `Roast Dinner' or Emily Watkins' venison dish `Shoot Lunch' prove a winner?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: For the South West chefs, which dessert will progress? Peach melba, apple pie and `Lolly and Sweets' fight it out.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's decision time for the chefs from the South West and only two remain. Who will cook their entire menus for the `Great British Menu' judges, Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton and their guest, writer and performer Simon Day? The judges aren't easily pleased and only world-class cooking will do.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The Welsh chefs raise the curtain with their starters, but which one is going to produce a showstopper? All three contestants have created sophisticated plates of food with simple dish titles. Will veteran Jeremy Lee be impressed with Richard Davies's chicken salad or will Mary Ann Gilchrist's peas and ham or Luke Thomas's ham, egg and pineapple get them off to a flying start?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The Welsh chefs cook their fish course. Richard Davies serves up grilled and tartare of mackerel, while Mary Ann Gilchrist serves a lobster dish and calls it `The Great Escape'. Luke Thomas is hoping that his quirky take on a classic fish finger will impress veteran Jeremy Lee too.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The Welsh chefs prepare their main courses, but will any of them impress veteran Jeremy Lee enough to give them a top score? Richard Davies's dish is simply called `A Tasting of Pork', Mary Ann Gilchrist's `Three's a Crowd' doesn't give much away, while Luke Thomas's dish is called `Beef, Bone Marrow and Watercress'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the final chance for the Welsh chefs to impress Jeremy Lee with their dessert dishes. Which creation will help get two chefs through to the judging show? Will it be Richard Davies's strawberries and cream with a Comic Relief twist, or will Mary Ann Gilchrist's `Some Like It Hot' or Luke Thomas's rhubarb and custard get them through?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Great British Menu continues as 24 of the nation's finest chefs battle it out to cook gastronomic masterpieces that are also witty and fun. Their dishes have to put a smile on faces as they compete for the prize of cooking a dish at a special banquet at the Royal Albert Hall celebrating 25 years of Comic Relief's Red Nose Day appeals. It is decision time for the chefs representing Wales.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three North East chefs all want to top the leader board on day one with their starter. How will Colin McGurran's tomato gazpacho and garden salad perform? Stephanie Moon thinks she also has a chance with a witty chicken dish called `Why Did the Chicken...', and Charlie Lakin offers a controversial duck dish called `Mind Your Step'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The North East chefs cook their fish courses. Will former champion Colin McGurran's dish of cockles and mussels with salmon, inspired by his childhood memories, also inspire veteran judge Jason Atherton? programme.title: Heartland Homicide
programme.desc: When Abbie Speir's body is pulled from her burning house in a quaint farming community, investigators quickly discover that the fire is no accident, and that a killer could be lurking closer to home than anyone can imagine.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Financier Allen Dorfman used union pension funds to bankroll the Mafia and the FBI quickly realised they could bankrupt the Mob by pursuing Dorfman.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Joe Valachi was the first Mafia member to break the Mob's code of silence and turn public informer, revealing the term `Cosa Nostra' to the world.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Gambino family soldier Roy DeMeo and his crew were suspected of killing dozens of people and dismembering their bodies, but the FBI and other mobsters were soon on his trail.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Meyer Lansky was an associate of `Lucky' Luciano and linked to criminal financial operations, but the FBI struggled to pin anything on him - or find his riches.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: The final episode of this gripping series reveals what happened when the FBI pursued the five clans who ran organised crime in New York, as well as the fate of two brave informers.

programme.title: Aileen: Life and Death of a Serial Killer
programme.desc: This feature-length film examines Aileen's harrowing life, tracing her story from the freezing woods of Michigan to the steamy swamps of Florida, and features her closest friends, her lawyers and even her estranged birth mother. At the heart of the film are the astonishing, unique, troubled interviews Broomfield filmed with Wuornos in prison, including her last, defiant words before execution.

programme.title: Aileen Wuornos: The Selling of a Serial Killer
programme.desc: Nick Broomfield explores the media circus surrounding the case of America's first textbook female serial killer.

programme.title: Holiday Love Rats Exposed
programme.desc: First of a three-part documentary series about people who have been conned out of money and left broken-hearted by someone they met on holiday.

programme.title: Holiday Love Rats Exposed
programme.desc: Three British women and an American describe how they met their husbands while they were abroad on holiday. One discovered that her husband was planning to leave her three years into their marriage after she had paid for his visa, while another reports that her ex-husband has asked her to look after his daughter from another marriage.

programme.title: Holiday Love Rats Exposed
programme.desc: Tracy, 54, travels to Turkey on a mission to get her money back from ex-lover Bulent, who has not paid back a business loan, and 51-year-old Anne Marie has over £14,000 of debt after being bamboozled by `Billy'.

programme.title: Moochie: Who Killed Jill Halliburton?
programme.desc: Jill Halliburton is murdered and police arrest a black man nicknamed Moochie. However, the testimony of the victim's son raises questions. Distressing scenes.

programme.title: Moochie: Who Killed Jill Halliburton?
programme.desc: Following Moochie's escape, the police organise a massive manhunt as supporters of the fugitive amongst the Black community make their voice heard.

programme.title: Moochie: Who Killed Jill Halliburton?
programme.desc: Crystal is arrested by the police and new charges are added to Moochie's file. These new elements cast doubt on his sincerity.

programme.title: Moochie: Who Killed Jill Halliburton?
programme.desc: The defence investigation reveals inconsistencies in the testimony of Nan-Yao, the victim's husband. Did he lie to the police? Could he be guilty?

programme.title: Moochie: Who Killed Jill Halliburton?
programme.desc: Moochie's trial begins. Even if the defence's role is not to solve the case, they will have to prove Moochie's innocence. Do they have enough evidence to do so?

programme.title: Moochie: Who Killed Jill Halliburton?
programme.desc: Following the cancellation of the first trial, the second begins. The defence seems to have changed its strategy. Will this new jury acquit Moochie?

programme.title: Private Violence
programme.desc: Filmmaker Cynthia Hill examines the case of Deanna Walters, a survivor of spousal abuse who embarks on a crusade for justice.

programme.title: Oscar Pistorius: The Shocking Release

programme.desc: 1994. Crime. Directed by Paul Greengrass. Stars Rupert Graves, Kate Hardie And Jim Carter. A compelling drama capturing the life of one of Britain's most wanted men during the 1980s - David Martin. [S]

programme.title: Resurrection of Zachary Wheeler
programme.desc: 1971. Sci-Fi starring Leslie Nielsen, Bradford Dillman and Don Haggerty. After a terrible car accident, a presidential candidate awakens in a New Mexico clinic without a trace of injury. [S]

programme.title: Melodies of the Moment - Glimpses
programme.desc: Melodies of the Moment. Mayhem and music abound at the offices of Messrs Pow Wham and Zowie Radio City.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Remounts. Western with Wayne Rogers And Robert Bray, who run a stagecoach line in the Old West where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress. [S]

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Quadripartite Affair. 1964. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum And Leo G. Carroll. Napoleon Solo and Illya Kuryakin face a four cornered conspiracy involving a chemical that induces fear. [S]

programme.title: Courageous Mr. Penn
programme.desc: 1942. Drama. Director: Lance Comfort. Stars Clifford Evans, Deborah Kerr And Dennis Arundell. Mr. Penn's deeds are told in this portrait of the founder of the Quakers and the Pennsylvania Colony. [S]

programme.title: The Large Rope
programme.desc: (AKA: The Long Rope). 1953. Drama. Director: Wolf Rilla. Stars Donald Houston, Susan Shaw And Peter Byrne. A man returns to where he was accused of murdering a girl to prove his innocence. [S]

programme.title: The Atomic Submarine
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Directed by Spencer Gordon Bennet. Stars Arthur Franz And Dick Foran. A submarine is sent out to investigate a series of naval disasters, but the crew also get caught up in the chaos. [S]

programme.title: Scandal Sheet (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Directed by Phil Karlson. Stars John Derek, Donna Reed And Broderick Crawford. A newspaper editor accidentally kills his ex-wife and his protégé is assigned to investigate the story. [S]

programme.title: Bespoke Overcoat
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Jack Clayton. Stars David Kossoff And Alfie Bass. A man's only desire is to have an overcoat, but dies of hypothermia and returns as a ghost demanding his friend steal him one [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Sing and dance along to the Johnny Otis Band as they perform the 1958 hit ''Willie and the Hand Jive''.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Bridge. 1957. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith And Ronald Leigh-Hunt. A plot is uncovered towards the Poltifax villagers by Squire Brian as he prepares for his knighthood. [S]

programme.title: By The Dome It's Known
programme.desc: For over 80 years the Southend Kursaal Amusement Park was a magnet to millions, now its story is brought to life with archive film and photographs of the memories of visitors and locals. [S]

programme.title: First Comes Courage
programme.desc: 1943. War. Directed by Dorothy Arzner. Stars Merle Oberon, Brian Aherne And Carl Esmond. A member of the Norwegian resistance faces complications when a British commando falls in love with her. [S]

programme.title: Albert R.N.

programme.desc: E10And so it finally arrived: 6th June 1944, the day that British, US and Canadian troops were sent across the English Channel to begin the job of reclaiming continental Europe and freeing it from German occupation.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E5Vera finds out her agents' fate. Her beliefs about Noor are challenged. Suspicions lead Vera to hunt down a Nazi mastermind.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E6Capture of a key Nazi uncovers shocking realities. Amid demands for accountability, as Vera and her team navigate murky waters to confront uncomfortable truths.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The definitive, if not the best, Axis fighter of World War two: we delve into the story of legendary ace Adolf Galland and examine in detail and example of the type in his colours. We also look at the technical heritage the 109 designers left.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The story of the prolonged development and the initially troubled operational history of the Boeing B-29 Superfortress. Forever known as the airframe that dropped the first atomic weapons on Japan, the B-29 lived on well beyond its war years.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E8Examining how the techniques of ambush, along with weapons that remained undetected until the very moment they were used, would revolutionise warfare.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E1Examining moments of engineering ingenuity which made the difference between triumph and disaster on the battlefield - beginning with World War I.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E10Experts look at three types of weapon employed to attack civilian populations, from the medieval trebuchet to modern bio-weapons and nuclear bombs.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft

programme.title: History Of Weapons

programme.title: History Of Weapons

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold

programme.title: Combat Machines

programme.title: Combat Machines

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E21942 and Hitler has the totally barking idea of using educated dogs to do a soldier's job. The Nazi leader wants to create fearsome canines to help him win the Second World War.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E3In 1914, Russian designer Nikolay Lebedenko decided to engineer a solution to the problem of trench warfare with an armoured vehicle with huge wheels that could move over any terrain.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The Yakovlev Yak-3, a Second World War Soviet fighter that was regarded for its performance at low altitudes and its agility. It was one of the most successful Soviet aircraft designs of the war.

programme.desc: E5Guy Walters and Justine across Italy in pursuit of Nazi gold. With historian Madeline, they uncover the story of Italy’s betrayal and looted treasure, before exploring the fortress of Fortezza and its underground caverns.

programme.desc: E6At the Fischerhütte restaurant, owner Albrecht Syen shares tales of past discoveries. On the lake itself, torrential rain and a comical attempt to use a GoPro as an underwater drone highlight the chaotic reality of treasure hunting.

programme.title: Die Nordreportage: Spezialauftrag Rettungswagen
programme.desc: Im Emsland baut der Fahrzeughersteller WAS Rettungswagen, die weltweit im Einsatz sind - von Saudi-Arabien bis London. Aktuell steht ein Spezialauftrag des Bundesamts für Katastrophenschutz und Bevölkerungssicherheit an: Deutschland will mit einer neuen Generation von Rettungsfahrzeugen besser auf Katastrophen vorbereitet sein. Ein Prototyp entsteht, der extreme Szenarien meistern soll. „Die Nordreportage“ begleitet die Entwicklung bis zum Test im Gelände.

programme.title: Wunderwelt Schweiz: Die Aare
programme.desc: Die Aare ist der längste Fluss, der nur auf Schweizer Gebiet verläuft. Von ihrer Quelle in den Berner Alpen bis zur Mündung in den Rhein bietet sie einen abwechslungsreichen Naturraum.

programme.title: unterwegs - Istanbul
programme.desc: Die Reisereportage lädt zu einer Entdeckungstour durch die Stadt am Bosporus ein. unterwegs ist Moderatorin Nicole Berchtold.

programme.title: unterwegs - Kroatien
programme.desc: Kroatien erlebt in den letzten Jahren einen regelrechten Boom: Lauschige Meeresbuchten, Weinberge, große Wälder, Seen und kulturhistorisch wertvolle Bauten sind dafür verantwortlich.

programme.title: unterwegs - Griechenland
programme.desc: Sonne, weiße Häuser und azurblaues Meer - in Griechenland werden Ferienträume wahr. Darüber hinaus begeistert das Land mit seinem mediterranen Flair.

programme.title: unterwegs - Südtirol
programme.desc: Andrea Jansen ist unterwegs im Südtirol - mit Roller, Rucksack und Rad. Ihre Reise führt sie durch eines der schönsten Wanderparadiese der Alpen, mit kilometerlangen Apfelfeldern, hervorragendem Essen und atemberaubenden Aussichten auf die Dolomiten.

programme.title: unterwegs - Schottland
programme.desc: Männer in Röcken, Dudelsack, Whisky und Loch Ness - über Schottland existieren unzählige Klischees. Doch das Land im Norden Großbritanniens hat weit mehr zu bieten.

programme.title: Kulturzeit
programme.desc: Das 3sat-Kulturmagazin von ZDF, ORF, SRF und ARD

programme.title: Propriozeption - Unser fantastischer Bewegungssinn
programme.desc: Die Tiefensensibilität unseres Körpers ist eine Superkraft, ohne die wir im Alltag nicht funktionieren würden. Deshalb müssen wir diesen sechsten Sinn ein Leben lang trainieren.

programme.title: Alpenpanorama
programme.desc: „Alpenpanorama“ zeigt über zahlreiche Web- und Panoramakameras täglich Livebilder aus ausgewählten Urlaubsorten in den Alpen.
